newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends firmer on month-end export deals.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends firmer on month-end export deals.

text.p: The won closed stronger versus the dollar on Friday, buoyed by month-end export negotiations which prompted dollar sales to limit losses, dealers said.
The won finished at 891.40 against Thursday's closing of 891.80. It traded in a range of 891.20 to 892.10. The won opened at the low.
Traders said end-of-the-month export deals were likely to continue to come through until early next week, holding the won at the 890 to 894 level next week.
Dealers expected the base mid-rate at 891.80 for Monday, unchanged from Friday. -- JEAN YOON (822) 727 5643
